say:1:1041571101:0.text: I saw many people wearing masks in Sal'thorin. Is this observance a particular point of local etiquette?
say:1:1041571101:0.source_cn: 我在萨洛克兰见过许多一直戴着面具的人，这是某种必要的社...

say:2:1041571102:0.text: Good heavens! I didn't have "discuss mundane mortal affairs with a Celestial" on my bingo card today. I must confess, I didn't expect that from you.
say:2:1041571102:0.source_cn: 哦，尊贵的半神大人竟然会对繁琐的人类事务感兴趣，这可真...

say:3:1041571103:1.text: That only shows you don't know me at all. I like to study the lives of mortals.
say:3:1041571103:1.source_cn: 那只能说明你不了解我。我喜欢研究凡人的生活方式。

say:4:1041571104:1.text: Your cuisines, your festivals, your captivating music. Every facet of your mortal existence is a wonder to behold.
say:4:1041571104:1.source_cn: 你们的美食、节日，还有音乐！哈，每一样都很有趣！

say:5:1041571105:1.text: Ah, then I shall endeavor to provide answers worthy of an audience as divine as yourself.
say:5:1041571105:1.source_cn: 啊，我明白了。我一定端正态度，为您答疑解惑。

say:6:1041571106:1.text: As for your previous question, in Sal'thorin, a mask is far more than an accessory. It's the very cornerstone of etiquette.
say:6:1041571106:1.source_cn: 至于您刚才那个问题的答案——是的，在萨洛克兰的社交礼仪...

say:8:1041571108:1.text: How can I explain it to you...?

say:9:1041571109:1.text: For a noble to remove their mask at a soiree is the equivalent of standing there stark naked. It's the most egregious breach of decorum imaginable.
say:9:1041571109:1.source_cn: 贵族在重要的社交场合摘下面具，简直就像赤身裸体一样。这...

say:10:1041571110:1.text: Oh, my Lady Archon, you do comprehend the term "stark naked", don't you?
say:10:1041571110:1.source_cn: 啊，半神大人，您应该理解“赤身裸体”这个词的意思。

say:11:1041571111:1.text: Yes, I'm aware of what that means...
say:11:1041571111:1.source_cn: 当然，我掌握这个词很久了。

say:12:1041571112:1.text: Okay, explain this to me. Why don't any of the commoners in Sal'thorin wear masks? Wait, I've just realized not every noble does either.
say:12:1041571112:1.source_cn: 不过为什么萨洛克兰的平民里基本没有戴面具的人？呃，好像...

say:13:1041571113:1.text: It's simple, really. We only wear masks for events that matter. An audience with the Queen, for instance... or the rare privilege of a conversation with a divine being like yourself.
say:13:1041571113:1.source_cn: 哈哈……当然是因为只有面见重要之人，才称得上是社交场合...

say:14:1041571114:1.text: Ah, I understand a bit more now.

say:15:1041571115:1.text: I think it'd be appropriate if I procured a mask. This gesture would honor Sal'thorin customs, would it not?
say:15:1041571115:1.source_cn: 总而言之，我最好有一张面具，戴上它能体现我对萨洛克兰人...

say:17:1041571117:1.text: Yes, I can provide you with a mask that matches mine. The Sal'thorin citizens would simply love to meet you. Someone like Velara in particular would never leave your side.
say:17:1041571117:1.source_cn: 如果您不介意，我可以为您提供一张和我脸上这张相同的面具...

say:18:1041571118:1.text: Wonderful! How can I thank you?
say:18:1041571118:1.source_cn: 噢，那真不错！我该怎么感谢你？

say:19:1041571119:1.text: No need for thanks, my Lady Archon. Besides, I happen to know a magical incantation that'll make any mortal your instant friend.
say:19:1041571119:1.source_cn: 不必这么客气，半神大人。我刚好还知道一句奇妙的咒语，只...

say:20:1041571120:1.text: Of course, using it does require a small price. But for someone of your stature? It'll hardly be a trifle.
say:20:1041571120:1.source_cn: 当然，使用它需要支付一些小小的代价，但以您的身份应该不...

say:21:1041571121:1.text: I didn't know there was such a spell. What is it?

say:23:1041571123:1.text: Allow me to give you a live demonstration! Look at the crowd here. Every single soul in this place is practically yearning for someone to say those words. Myself included.
say:23:1041571123:1.source_cn: 我现在就带您实践一下。正好有很多人在这里，他们都期待着...
